supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: prominent lateral extension beyond the visible outer corner of the eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: low contrast; the muzzle area is slightly lighter charcoal than the very dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick, with a distinct structural droop of the lower lip

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: significant irregular notch or structural loss on the superior helix

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: small white punctate mark on the central cheek; morphological notch in the upper ear helix
other_distinctive_markers: white debris or skin marker on mid-cheek
